name: ipad-tcg
accel_note: Intel Windows host: TCG is mandatory. The launcher refuses any other accelerator (accelerator_not_tcg).
cpu_model_note: Candidate only; M0/M4 resolves against the pinned board.toml (PRD 6 WP04).
memory_note: Host has 15.8GB total with ~3.4GB free at inventory; keep guest RAM conservative and record peak RSS.

display.note: ramfb/GOP path first (PRD 4.2); VirtIO GPU software path probed at M9a.

data_disk.note: Persistent Data volume; route decided by H04 (M9b)

input.note: Text input may start on the guest on-screen keyboard (FR04)

net.note: M13; disabled for MVP boot gates

control.note: QMP over Windows socket; serial and control must not contend

disks.artifact_root_note: C: has 0.6GB free; never place images there.
